text.value:
DECLARE @getmetadataoutput VARCHAR(MAX)
SET @getmetadataoutput = '@{activity('Get Metadata1').output.childItems}'

SELECT * from openJson(@getmetadataoutput) with (FolderName varchar(50) '$.name')
where isdate(FolderName) = 1

text.value:
UPDATE dbo.sf_watermark
SET last_run_time = '@{formatDateTime(activity('Lookup Max Last Run Time').output.firstRow.last_run_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')}',
    last_run_status = 'Success',
    record_count = @{activity('Copy Data From Accounts').output.rowsCopied}
WHERE object_name = 'Account'
